purpose: Machine-readable Arknoz policy for routing project media through jurisdiction, subject-rights and licence-compliance gates before storage or publication.
principles: External media presence does not itself authorize Arknoz publication.
A free licence on the photograph and copyright treatment of the depicted work are separate checks.
Unknown jurisdiction rules fail closed to RIGHTS_REVIEW.
Architectural photographs and architectural drawings are different rights cases.
Automated passage through this policy means storage/publication eligibility only when all other Arknoz gates also pass.
Human review remains available for ambiguous identity, subject type, licence, provenance or jurisdiction.

default_policy.reason: Jurisdiction has not yet been configured in the Arknoz media-rights policy registry.

supporting_reference.title: Wikimedia Commons — Copyright rules by territory/Australia

basis.rule: Copyright in a building or model of a building is not infringed by making a photograph of the building or model.
Publication of a photograph is not an infringement where its making did not infringe by virtue of section 65, 66 or 67.

conditions: The media asset must genuinely be a photograph of the Project building or model.
The photographer/file copyright must separately pass Arknoz licence policy.
Required attribution and licence metadata must be preserved.
Any material restriction or conflicting rights metadata returns the asset to RIGHTS_REVIEW.

building_drawing_or_plan.reason: Do not treat an architectural drawing or plan as equivalent to a photograph of the constructed building.

interior_artwork.reason: Separate depicted artworks or other protected material may require their own analysis.

basis.rule: Certain sculptures and works of artistic craftsmanship situated otherwise than temporarily in a public place or premises open to the public may be photographed.

sculpture_or_artistic_craftsmanship.reason: Subject classification and permanence/public-place conditions must first be established.
